# Kazakhstan Travel (almaty-travel.kz)

> Private tours from Almaty, Kazakhstan, by Kazakhstan Travel — a tour operator working since 2011 with about 700–1000 travellers a year. Private SUV (4x4) tours with an English-speaking driver-guide to Charyn Canyon, Kolsai and Kaindy lakes, Altyn-Emel National Park, Tamgaly-Tas, Big Almaty Lake and the Almaty mountains; also a private driver-guide with a car, winter programmes (heli-ski, freeride, ski lessons), helicopter and airplane flights, horse riding and yurt stays. Site languages: English (/en/) and Russian (/ru/, home page /).

Prices are not published: every tour is calculated individually. Contact: WhatsApp +7 777 525 98 85, e-mail kztravel@mail.ru, online form https://www.almaty-travel.kz/en/order/. Instagram: @kazakhstan_travel.

What the tour price includes: private 4x4 SUV and all transport costs, English-speaking driver-guide, pickup and drop-off at your hotel in Almaty, national park entrance tickets and eco fees, drinking water. Meals and accommodation are paid separately, or booked as the All inclusive package (hotels in the national parks and meals). Every tour can be customised; a private driver-guide with a car (transport only) is also available. Kazakhstan Travel runs tours in Kazakhstan only.

## Quick answers
- Charyn Canyon in one day from Almaty: yes, private day tour 9:00-19:00 with hotel pickup.
- Kolsai, Kaindy and Charyn in one day: possible on the express tour (6:00-23:00); two days is more comfortable.
- Altyn-Emel from Almaty: about four hours drive each way; day trips or a 2-day tour with a night in Basshi village.
- Tours are private: only your group in the car, with your own English-speaking driver-guide. No shared group tours.
- Meals and accommodation are not in the tour price: paid separately or booked as the All inclusive package.
- Price: on request via WhatsApp +7 777 525 98 85 with dates, number of travellers and places.
